title: Sordland/Turn04/A_ConvinceAlbin
description:
USP PARTY MEETING

Private Talk:

-Talk to Albin (already supports) & Gloria to sway the conservative wing

Party Speech:

-Presentation of the new reforms to the party

-Party reformist faction backs the President

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How is everything going, Mr. Clavi..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is everything going, Mr. Clavin?"
entries.menuText: "How is everything going, Mr. Clavin?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After our meeting with Gloria Tory,..."
entries.dialogueText: After our meeting with Gloria Tory, and further discussions with the party and my cabinet, it was time to talk to Albin Clavin to get the reformist wing to support the proposal.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Mr. President! Welcome!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President! Welcome!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I also planned to finally present a..."
entries.dialogueText: I also planned to finally present a more fleshed out proposal and declare our agenda to the party after our meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked into the left wing of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked into the left wing of the Assembly and entered the quarters of the USP. When I reached the meeting hall, I saw many of our members conversing inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After taking a glimpse inside, I we..."
entries.dialogueText: After taking a glimpse inside, I went back into the corridor to look for the office of Albin Clavin, which was around the back of the place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I reached his room, I knocked..."
entries.dialogueText: When I reached his room, I knocked on his door and entered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The whole room was surrounded by bo..."
entries.dialogueText: The whole room was surrounded by bookshelves packed with files and papers. It was a small office, with books and dossiers lying on every corner. It felt claustrophobic.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On his gesture, I took a seat."
entries.dialogueText: On his gesture, I took a seat.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Did a bomb drop in this office?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did a bomb drop in this office?"
entries.menuText: "Did a bomb drop in this office?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's been busy. The party has been..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been busy. The party has been working very hard, Mr. President. Thank you for asking."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""How is it going for you in the Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is it going for you in the Palace?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You could say that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You could say that."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""So much research and preparation n..."
entries.dialogueText: "So much research and preparation needs to be done on the plans we're working on."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""How is everything going for you, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is everything going for you, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's pretty tough.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's pretty tough."
entries.menuText: "It's pretty tough."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm feeling pretty good.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm feeling pretty good."
entries.menuText: "I'm feeling pretty good."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It depends on our meeting today.""
entries.dialogueText: "It depends on our meeting today."
entries.menuText: "It depends on our meeting today."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Oh, I see. Then I'll try my best n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I see. Then I'll try my best not to make it any worse for you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I can't imagine the work you're de..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't imagine the work you're dealing with up there."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That's great to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's great to hear."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Anyway, sir, let's talk about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway, sir, let's talk about the proposal. Thanks for coming here for my input because there are some subjects where Gloria and I don't see eye to eye."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I have to say that most of the pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say that most of the progressives were already starting to warm up to you. Your attempt at changing the constitution created quite a bit of excitement. One could dare to say an excitement that hasn't been felt since the 30's..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Yet, there are some issues with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet, there are some issues with the current status of the draft proposal. So we may need to contain our excitement a little longer."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I've read the proposal that was fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've read the proposal that was finalised together with Mrs. Tory. And surprisingly, it came out pretty good."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I have to say that the proposal is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say that the proposal is unacceptable in its current state."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The meeting had exhausted me."
entries.dialogueText: The meeting had exhausted me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went to the restaurant of the Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: I went to the restaurant of the Assembly to get something to eat while conversing with other members of our party.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Albin talking to his people i..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Albin talking to his people in the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a while, the preparations for..."
entries.dialogueText: After a while, the preparations for the conference began and I went back into the conference hall and prepared my notes for the speech I was going to make.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It took time to get all of the pres..."
entries.dialogueText: It took time to get all of the present members of the party inside the hall. Gloria Tory announced me from the stand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked up to the stand as everybo..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked up to the stand as everybody in the room started clapping.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Dear members of Assembly, I came h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear members of Assembly, I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entries.menuText: "Dear members of Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and gentlemen of the Party!..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Party! I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Party!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Brothers and sisters of United Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brothers and sisters of United Sordland! I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entries.menuText: "Brothers and sisters of United Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I started my speech with the reason..."
entries.dialogueText: I started my speech with the reasons of the changes to the Constitution.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The people of Sordland have spoken..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Sordland have spoken! They blame our institutions and our systems, and want change! Can you blame the people? Haven't we had enough with the flaws of our Constitution? We must listen their wishes, and get their trust in Sordland back!"
entries.menuText: "The people of Sordland have spoken..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our system and institutions have i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our system and institutions have increasingly became undemocratic over the decades after Soll tightened his grip on the country. Since then, we have a Supreme Court that obstructs the duties of the President and the Assembly. We must finally be brave enough to go against the status quo that they created and write a new Constitution!"
entries.menuText: "Our system and institutions have increasingly became undemocratic..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Supreme Court is blocking the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court is blocking the future of Sordland yet again, since President Soll has placed these Judges there. They believe that they are the sole protectors of the Constitution and real leaders of Sordland even though they weren't even elected. We must be brave enough to break their power over us and bring the change Sordland has been so eagerly waiting for!"
entries.menuText: "The Supreme Court is blocking the future of Sordland..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused as they started clapping a..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused as they started clapping and continued.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused when some people started c..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused when some people started clapping but it was short lived. After taking a breath, I continued.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I brought attention to democracy an..."
entries.dialogueText: I brought attention to democracy and why we must write a more democratic Constitution. I explained how our proposal will fix the issues.
entries.menuText: Talk about democracy.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I brought attention to the people's..."
entries.dialogueText: I brought attention to the people's protests and the slight decrease in the popularity of USP. I explained how our proposal will only be beneficial for everybody.
entries.menuText: Talk about why USP needs this to survive the next elections.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I blamed the Old Guards for not all..."
entries.dialogueText: I blamed the Old Guards for not allowing the legislative to do their work. I explained how more reforms can be done if their power over constitutional changes were to be limited.
entries.menuText: Target the Old Guards and the Supreme Court.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A round of applause from the left w..."
entries.dialogueText: A round of applause from the left was heard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The left side of the hall where Alb..."
entries.dialogueText: The left side of the hall where Albin sat started applauding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moderates that sat in the centr..."
entries.dialogueText: The moderates that sat in the centre started applauding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Later I explained the contents of t..."
entries.dialogueText: Later I explained the contents of the new Constitution and asked for their full support for the proposal.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I announced that any opposition to..."
entries.dialogueText: I announced that any opposition to the proposal will not be tolerated and will be declared as traitors to the party.
entries.menuText: Threaten them to vote yes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I asked for each and every member's..."
entries.dialogueText: I asked for each and every member's vote to make a change together.
entries.menuText: Ask for their votes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I told them what they must do and w..."
entries.dialogueText: I told them what they must do and what was expected of them.
entries.menuText: Order them to vote yes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reformist wing on the left stoo..."
entries.dialogueText: The reformist wing on the left stood up and started clapping loudly after Albin Clavin made a sign.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, most of the party membe..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, most of the party members stood up and joined in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The conservatives on the right side..."
entries.dialogueText: The conservatives on the right side of the hall where Gloria sat stood up and started clapping loudly after I saw Gloria making a gesture with her hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There wasn't much reaction from the..."
entries.dialogueText: There wasn't much reaction from the party.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saluted everybody in the room one..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted everybody in the room one last time and bid them farewell before leaving the stand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked outside the Assembly and b..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked outside the Assembly and back into the Palace...

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That would have been very nice for..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would have been very nice for you, wouldn't it, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""With all due respect, maybe you sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, maybe you shouldn't forget that it is the party that made you president."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""A fact that I'm aware of.""
entries.dialogueText: "A fact that I'm aware of."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I am.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""But us democrats have already esta..."
entries.dialogueText: "But us democrats have already established our demands, which were apparently ignored by you."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You cannot claim that you're the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot claim that you're the democrat here."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""But at this point, even my support..."
entries.dialogueText: "But at this point, even my support would not be enough."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Where to even begin?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where to even begin?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's hear your problems.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hear your problems."
entries.menuText: "Let's hear your problems."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How about some other deal?""
entries.dialogueText: "How about some other deal?"
entries.menuText: "How about some other deal?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't let you sabotage this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't let you sabotage this."
entries.menuText: "I can't let you sabotage this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't forget who you are speaking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget who you are speaking to."
entries.menuText: "Don't forget who you are speaking to."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean?"
entries.menuText: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell me the issues. How can I get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me the issues. How can I get your support?"
entries.menuText: "Tell me the issues. How can I get your support?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""This proposal will have hard time..."
entries.dialogueText: "This proposal will have hard time getting support in its current status. You surely know that."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You are sabotaging yourself if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are sabotaging yourself if you're not willing to listen the reformists in your own party..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""First, I'll say that I'm concerned..."
entries.dialogueText: "First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the drastic decrease in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott it."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That will have negative consequenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of parties could potentially enter the parliament. The electoral finance reform reduces their ability to campaign but nonetheless the situation won't be in our favour at all."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""We have specifically asked for a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have specifically asked for a change in appointment of ministers. This is what the party was expecting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused and twiddled his thumbs."
entries.dialogueText: He paused and twiddled his thumbs.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Yet I see that our suggestions wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet I see that our suggestions were completely ignored."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Excuse me, Mr. President, but how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, Mr. President, but how are they not ignored?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's not a priority for us.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's not a priority for us."
entries.menuText: "That's not a priority for us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They were not ignored, Mr. Clavin.""
entries.dialogueText: "They were not ignored, Mr. Clavin."
entries.menuText: "They were not ignored, Mr. Clavin."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can address that now.""
entries.dialogueText: "We can address that now."
entries.menuText: "We can address that now."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I don't know what I can do for you..."

entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Who's us? Isn't the party included..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Oh?""

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gloria and the conservatives didn'..."

entries.menuText: "Gloria and the conservatives didn't seem to have any problems with it."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""What is that supposed to mean? *We..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is that supposed to mean? *We* have a problem with it."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Let's see then...""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's see then..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Here. I already have my suggestion..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here. I already have my suggestion here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled out a stack of papers and..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled out a stack of papers and placed them on his desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The papers contained suggested amen..."
entries.dialogueText: The papers contained suggested amendments to the Constitution.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I skimmed through the law he pointe..."
entries.dialogueText: I skimmed through the law he pointed out. "Council of Ministers are formed upon the President's appointment of them from a list of nominees that the Grand National Assembly selects."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Leave the rest of the party to me...."
entries.dialogueText: "Leave the rest of the party to me. I am now asking for *your* support."
entries.menuText: "Leave the rest of the party to me. I am now asking for *your* support."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can add the requested change to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can add the requested change to the proposal."
entries.menuText: "We can add the requested change to the proposal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Screw the party.""

entries.menuText: "Screw the party."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Oh yeah?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh yeah?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Your proposal will be crushed like..."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That's a shame.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's a shame."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""How about two of those cheques you..."
entries.dialogueText: "How about two of those cheques you're holding?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Here you go.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here you go."
entries.menuText: "Here you go. [Give him two cheques for -2 Personal Wealth]"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How about only one for now?""
entries.dialogueText: "How about only one for now?"
entries.menuText: "How about only one for now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's too much.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's too much."
entries.menuText: "That's too much."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I thought you were a wealthy man...""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you were a wealthy man..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Here's one. This will be enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here's one. This will be enough."
entries.menuText: "Here's one. This will be enough. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think there won't be any deal to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think there won't be any deal today."
entries.menuText: "I think there won't be any deal today."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""That's a shame.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's a shame."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Glad to be making business with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to be making business with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took the cheque and slid it into..."
entries.dialogueText: He took the cheque and slid it into the pocket of his jacket.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at the proposal on the t..."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at the proposal on the table.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Now your offer has indeed become s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now your offer has indeed become something very persuasive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course. I am a man of my word.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I am a man of my word."
entries.menuText: "Of course. I am a man of my word."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't intend to run with Petr ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't intend to run with Petr again. It'll be you, I promise."
entries.menuText: "I don't intend to run with Petr again. It'll be you, I promise."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As long as I get your support.""
entries.dialogueText: "As long as I get your support."
entries.menuText: "As long as I get your support."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Good. Then it seems like we have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Then it seems like we have a deal."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I won't create any problems.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't create any problems."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's what I wanted to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I wanted to hear."
entries.menuText: "That's what I wanted to hear."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's good to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's good to know."
entries.menuText: "That's good to know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Clavin. Any help fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin. Any help from you is much appreciated."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin. Any help from you is much appreciated."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I wanted to express my gratitude f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to express my gratitude for passing the Workers' Rights Act. It is one of my most comprehensive and successful political efforts."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Our team was disappointed by the v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our team was disappointed by the veto of the Workers' Rights Act. We worked day and night for weeks. It would have boosted your public opinion too, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It wasn't a good time for a drasti..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't a good time for a drastic changes which would also costs the government."
entries.menuText: "It wasn't a good time for a drastic changes which would also costs the government."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You and I see eye to eye on many s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and I see eye to eye on many subjects including this one."
entries.menuText: "You and I see eye to eye on many subjects including this one."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The businesses would be burdened e..."
entries.dialogueText: "The businesses would be burdened even further. In this climate it would damage the economy."
entries.menuText: "The businesses would be burdened even further. In this climate it would damage the economy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your efforts were appreciated by t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your efforts were appreciated by the Palace."
entries.menuText: "Either way, your efforts were appreciated by the Palace."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was the right thing to do becau..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was the right thing to do because our workers were suffering for decades."
entries.menuText: "It was the right thing to do because our workers were suffering for decades."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The party effort had to be support..."
entries.dialogueText: "The party effort had to be supported."
entries.menuText: "The party effort had to be supported."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Indeed the people will credit your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed the people will credit your administration and the party for a positive change in their lives."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I have to say, the close collabora..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say, the close collaboration between the palace and the party is going well. Looking forward to what we can accomplish with the reforms."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Music to my ears.""
entries.dialogueText: "Music to my ears."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It never is. Not sure how this wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "It never is. Not sure how this will reflect on the public opinion, I wouldn't imagine positively."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I understand your perspective but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your perspective but haven't the companies benefitted from this situation and made profit for a long time?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Actions would have gone farther th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actions would have gone farther than words."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It seems that the administration i..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems that the administration is taking a very pro-business approach."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Albin smiled and knocked on wood."
entries.dialogueText: Albin smiled and knocked on wood.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He poured himself some water and ha..."
entries.dialogueText: He poured himself some water and had a sip before continuing.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's just that we thought the Pala..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's just that we thought the Palace wouldn't let us down."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The businesses will share the burd..."
entries.dialogueText: "The businesses will share the burden with the state but it is a change they have to abide by."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The worker's revolution will begin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The worker's revolution will begin with small steps."
entries.menuText: "The worker's revolution will begin with small steps."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""One would think that I'm talking t..."
entries.dialogueText: "One would think that I'm talking to Ms. Walda. The party doesn't support such ideologies as you know."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Personally there are some principl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Personally there are some principles that I respect in Malenyevism but I wouldn't accept it in it's entirety."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is a market economy with a free..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a market economy with a free supply and demand system. The government shouldn't overregulate."
entries.menuText: "It is a market economy with a free supply and demand system. The government shouldn't overregulate."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The situation is borderline exploi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The situation is borderline exploitative, that is why the majority of the assembly gathered behind it. The act was supposed to bring some regulation which didn't exist before."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It wouldn't be possible without Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wouldn't be possible without Paskal Beniwoll's support. The Labour Union and several NGO's like Magnus Cartus also contributed to the campaigning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Albin sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Albin sighed.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""First, I'll say that I'm concerned..."
entries.dialogueText: "First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the increase in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott that since the expectation from us is to democratise, not do the opposite."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Our constituents wouldn't accept t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our constituents wouldn't accept the situation."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The change will have negative cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "The change will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of new parties could potentially enter the parliament."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Combined with the electoral financ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Combined with the electoral finance reform no other party can ever make it to the parliament. Our constituents wouldn't accept the situation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. I will remove the increase i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I will remove the increase in the threshold."
entries.menuText: "Fine. I will remove the increase in the threshold."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You are removing the Justices' imm..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are removing the Justices' immunity and giving the ability to impeach it to the parliament. I'm a parliamentarian at heart and while I think this strengthens the people's representative power, it still is wrong."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Who do you think we are to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who do you think we are to support such changes, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will remove the changes to the i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices."
entries.menuText: " I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""And you're doing more than that, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you're doing more than that, aren't you? Taking away the immunity of the Justices and giving the power to replace them to yourself. A worrying notion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will remove the decrease in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remove the decrease in the threshold."
entries.menuText: "I will remove the decrease in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will remove the increase in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remove the increase in the threshold."
entries.menuText: "I will remove the increase in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""This particular change is specific..."
entries.dialogueText: "This particular change is specifically worrying as it represents an opposite trend. The decrees need to be weaker not stronger."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To truly reform the country the Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "To truly reform the country the President needs decrees not subject to review."
entries.menuText: "To truly reform the country the President needs decrees not subject to review."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What is wrong with a USP President..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is wrong with a USP President having strong decree powers?"
entries.menuText: "What is wrong with a USP President having strong decree powers?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I respect the perspective of the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect the perspective of the reformist wing."
entries.menuText: "I respect the perspective of the reformist wing."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""What I didn't expect was a worseni..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I didn't expect was a worsening of the current situation. Presidential decrees above statute law and not subject to judicial review... It would destroy the separation of powers."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""And the attempt to offset this by..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the attempt to offset this by adding an override of the veto power to the parliament only to have no time limit to act is a very low move. Tricks like this won't go unnoticed."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I thought you wanted to discuss a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you wanted to discuss a change..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There must be another way.""
entries.dialogueText: "There must be another way."
entries.menuText: "There must be another way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. Let's change the law and lim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees."
entries.menuText: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think I want that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think I want that."
entries.menuText: "I don't think I want that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't let the Assembly control m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't let the Assembly control me."
entries.menuText: "I can't let the Assembly control me."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Lovely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lovely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't trust the Assembly to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."
entries.menuText: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Lovely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lovely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It makes sense. I will include you..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees."
entries.menuText: "It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The fact that we are giving the As..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that we are giving the Assembly the power to override a veto is change enough."
entries.menuText: "The fact that we are giving the Assembly the power to override a veto is change enough."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""You didn't include any time limit..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't include any time limit for that response thus creating a loophole which puts us back to square one. Nothing."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""And if you really care about furth..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if you really care about further democratic reforms, we'll issue the enabling act. But we have to make sure the presidents can't work alone anymore."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""I suggest limiting the power of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest limiting the power of the decrees with an enabling act. The Assembly should have some control over a potential rogue president."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Well there were some subjects that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well there were some subjects that were wrong about Tarquin Soll and we don't want to see a repeat of that."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Enough to make a slight change tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough to make a slight change that would heavily influence our tendencies to support the draft?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Why can't the President work close..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why can't the President work closely with the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Which under this draft proposal al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which under this draft proposal also would have immunity for life once retired."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""And your abolishment of the honora..."
entries.dialogueText: "And your abolishment of the honorary membership indicates that you are a democrat too."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""But the extent of your democratic..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the extent of your democratic beliefs matter."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""The removal of the honorary member..."
entries.dialogueText: "The removal of the honorary membership won't be respected by the party either."

entries.dialogueText: I took out a cheque and showed it to him. It immediately got his attention.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He took the cheque and slid it into the pocket of his jacket.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""Glad to be making business with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to be making business with you."

entries.title: Player: ""I will give the Assembly the power..."

entries.title: Narrator: "He took a deep breath then let out..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a deep breath then let out a long sigh.

entries.title: Player: ""On a second thought, I'm fine with..."
entries.dialogueText: "On a second thought, I'm fine with the current draft."
entries.menuText: "On a second thought, I'm fine with the current draft."
